OpenAi._BatchInlineImage: true sends the base image inline as base64 instead of by file_id — an escape hatch for OpenAI's batch file-resolution outage. Tried Aug 2026, did not help; see CLAUDE.md.

Pipeline._ShortPrompts: true also writes {runFolder}/short-prompts/ — a shorter copy of every era prompt for pasting by hand into tools that mangle the long form. Same output as the 'short-prompts' CLI mode.

Publish._: Connectors are code only — nothing reads this section yet. Fill it in when the publish mode lands.

Telegram._ChatId: A channel is @name or its -100… id; the bot must be an admin of it.

Dropbox._: RefreshToken + AppKey + AppSecret renews itself and is what a scheduled run needs. AccessToken alone lives four hours.

Instagram._UserId: The Instagram professional account id (numeric), not the username. Needs instagram_content_publish.

Facebook._: A Page token, not a user token — the user token can read the Page but cannot publish as it. Needs pages_manage_posts + publish_video.

YouTube._Privacy: Never defaulted in code. private + a schedule is the safe pattern: YouTube flips each video public on its own.
